api.notes: Martensite selected application-owner queries preserve actual cursor selection, owning copy identity and intrusive counts through null-owner, replacement, clear, retained-copy and second-object transitions. Seven actual pinned native rows repeat exactly and replay in Rust. Native requires a selected interactive object; explicit Rust guard covers the otherwise undefined null dereference. No native exception or whole-context completion credit. See docs/selected-application-owners.md and porting/runtime-evidence/selected-applicative/.
